```{r}
library("metafor")
library("RoBMA")
data("dat.bangertdrowns2004", package = "metadat")
dat <- dat.bangertdrowns2004
dat$ni100 <- dat$ni / 100
fit2_metafor <- suppressWarnings(rma(yi, vi, mods = ~ ni100, scale = ~ ni100, data = dat))
fit2_brma <- readRDS("../models/12-metafor-parity-location-scale/fit2_brma.RDS")
cat("metafor class:", class(fit2_metafor), "\n")
cat("brma class:", class(fit2_brma), "\n")

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
metafor::regplot(fit2_metafor, mod = "ni100", pi = TRUE)
regplot(fit2_brma, mod = "ni100", pi = TRUE)
```
